witnesses.statement: The rig was still on its stand when I took a tray past the store room at ten past seven. By twenty to eight the stand was empty.
Whoever came out of the store room corridor carrying something bulky had a yellow lanyard. I did not see a face.
One car pulled out in a hurry just before quarter to eight. Everyone else was still parked when I locked the barrier at ten.
Three people wear yellow lanyards this year: Mara Velez, Ines Carvalho and Sofia Lind. Mentors wear blue, volunteers green.
